note: FC Mobile PlayStyles, grouped by category, with the main stat(s) each one boosts. FC Mobile has two tiers: a base tier (Silver) and a stronger tier (Gold) - in this app the 'plus' flag on a player's PlayStyle means Gold, and 'plus_multiplier' scales the bonus. The exact in-game per-attribute numbers are not published in a free, machine-readable form, so the bonus VALUES here are placeholders you can tune; the LIST and which stat each affects follow the public 2026 PlayStyles guides. Because scoring and upgrades prioritise the stats a player's PlayStyles boost, keeping this list correct matters more than the exact numbers. Stat keys are the six main stats; for goalkeepers those keys map to GK stats (see rules/stat_weights.json GK note).
